title: Quantitative reconstruction from finite causal orders in a conformal diamond
description:
Draft preprint by Daniel Eric Fredriksen, Quantyra Inc., version 0.2.0. For smooth densities on the unit square between 1/2 and 3/2, with uniform marginals and Euclidean Lipschitz constant at most two, iid finite directed causal-order laws yield the explicit coefficient inverse bound 100(N^(-1/12) + Delta_N). A logarithmic grid scale improves the sample-size term to give 130((log N/N)^(1/6) + Delta_N), for every integer N at least two.

The deterministic occupied-grid finite realizer rank theorem is Lean verified. The full probability-to-density inverse theorem, label-law equivalence and proper-time comparison remain prose proofs in this manuscript version. The constants are conservative; no optimal exponent, practical sample budget, general spacetime reconstruction or new physics is claimed. Originality remains provisional, including outstanding full-text literature comparisons.

Developed with OpenAI Codex assistance under the author's research direction. Quantyra follows open-source, decentralized informal feedback and downstream use/testing; specialist review is not a publication prerequisite. Manuscript and source: CC-BY-4.0. The related version 0.1.0 software DOI identifies a separate Apache-2.0 software release and its original included preprint, not this manuscript deposit.
